title: Sphere dropped on a plane: apex heights H_k+1 / H_k = e^2; e = 0 does not bounce

tol.derivation: H_k+1 = (e v)^2 / 2g - e v h / 2 (the scheme's discrete apex after leaving at e v, v = sqrt(2 g H_k)) within 2 e^2 v h + 2 e^2 g h^2 + g h^2 + 8u: the pre-solve approach speed is within [v - g h, v + 2 g h]; apexes are refined by a parabola through three records, exact for the scheme's free flight; e = 0: height after contact <= g h^2, speed <= 2 g h (the restitution threshold)
tol.source: Newton's law of restitution; Müller et al. 2020 §3.6
